title: Brand Marketing Assistant
description:
Hiring due to a period of extended growth

Would you be excited by the opportunity to work with an internationally recognised premium brand within a global marketing team?

The role would suit an organised and creative individual with previous experience within Marketing, who is looking to develop their career within a global brand environment.

You will support a wide range of activities including content creation, product launches, trade shows, market research and international marketing campaigns.

The successful candidate will have excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills and a proactive, can-do approach. Practical Adobe InDesign experience is essential, with Photoshop, HubSpot or content management experience highly desirable.

Job Type: Full-time & Permanent

Job Title: Brand Marketing Assistant

Salary: 28,000 to 30,000

Hours: 40 hours per week

Location: Guildford - One day a week from home.

Brand Marketing Assistant Responsibilities:
- Managing marketing assets including brochures, specification sheets, photography, video and sales tools
- Updating marketing literature using Adobe InDesign, following approved templates and brand guidelines
- Coordinating literature updates, translations and publication across relevant websites and marketing portals
- Managing document control and ensuring internal teams and distributors have access to the latest materials
- Supporting marketing campaigns, product launches, trade shows and events
- Responding to routine marketing enquiries and coordinating regional requests
- Liaising with agencies, suppliers and translation providers when required
- Monitoring market research, industry news and competitor activity to identify relevant insights and trends
- Working closely with Marketing, Sales, Product Management, Culinary and Aftersales teams

Brand Marketing Assistant Desirable Skills:
- Previous experience within Marketing, Communications, Design, Sales Support or a similar environment
- Practical Adobe InDesign experience is essential, including editing templates and preparing print-ready PDFs
- Excellent attention to detail, proofreading and file-management skills
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- Good knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel
- Experience with content management systems, digital asset platforms or marketing portals
- Photoshop and HubSpot/CRM experience would be beneficial
- Experience within Engineering, Manufacturing or another technical environment would be desirable
- A proactive, flexible and collaborative approach to work

title: CRM Executive
description:
Excellent Benefits

Hybrid Working - 3 Days in the Office

We are recruiting for an exciting CRM & Partnerships Executive opportunity with a successful and growing consumer-focused business.

Working closely with the Senior Digital Marketing Manager, you will support the delivery of customer email campaigns, automated journeys and CRM activity, while also taking responsibility for affiliate and external partnership relationships.

This is a varied role combining CRM, email marketing, affiliate marketing, partnerships and campaign analysis, making it an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their career within a fast-paced digital marketing environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage email marketing campaigns from initial planning through to delivery, testing and performance analysis.
- Support the development of CRM strategies designed to increase customer engagement, retention and repeat purchasing.
- Create and manage automated customer journeys including welcome, re-engagement, abandoned browse and abandoned basket campaigns.
- Develop customer segmentation strategies using behavioural, transactional and engagement data.
- Build targeted customer audiences to deliver relevant and personalised communications.
- Carry out regular A/B testing to improve email and campaign performance.
- Work closely with internal teams including Buying, Merchandising, Design, Customer Service and eCommerce.
- Analyse campaign performance and provide clear reporting and recommendations.
- Monitor key CRM measures including engagement, conversion, revenue, customer retention and ROI.
- Manage day-to-day relationships with affiliate partners and external agencies.
- Identify and onboard new affiliate and commercial partners.
- Support the negotiation and management of affiliate commission structures.
- Develop promotional opportunities and incentives for affiliate partners.
- Coordinate promotional assets, product information and campaign materials.
- Review affiliate performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Monitor key performance indicators including revenue, traffic, conversion, CPA, ROAS and average order value.
- Support partnership and retail media campaigns with external suppliers and brands.
- Coordinate partnership activity from initial agreement through to campaign delivery and post-campaign analysis.
- Build strong relationships with external partners and identify opportunities for collaborative marketing activity.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone with:
- Previous experience using a CRM or email marketing platform.
- Experience within digital marketing, CRM, eCommerce or affiliate marketing.
- An understanding of email campaigns, segmentation and automated customer journeys.
- Strong analytical skills and confidence interpreting campaign performance.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- A commercially focused approach with an understanding of ROI and performance.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities within a fast-paced environment.
- Strong problem-solving skills.
- Confidence communicating results and recommendations to stakeholders.

title: Organic Social and Content Specialist
description:
Organic Social & Content Specialist

Location: Woking, Surrey Hybrid (2 days per week in the office)
Salary: £32,000 £37,000 per annum
Job Type: Permanent

We are working with an established and growing B2 B marketing agency that is looking for an experienced Organic Social & Content Specialist to join its Content & Creative team.

You will ideally have:
- Proven experience managing organic social media for multiple clients.
- Strong LinkedIn knowledge and experience creating content specifically for B2 B audiences.
- A portfolio demonstrating excellent social and written content.

title: Sponsorship Marketing & Hubsot CRM Manager
description:
Hybrid working: 2 days in office

B2 B sponsorship pipelines at media companies with real industry profile on the calendar. This is the role that owns the engine behind them, building the CRM infrastructure and lead-generation function from scratch rather than inheriting someone else's setup.
- Own a brand-new function from the ground up
- Hybrid working, Mondays and Tuesdays in the office
- Clear progression as the division scales
- Work on high-profile B2 B events for your portfolio
- Active team social life
- Established, collaborative in-house team around you

The Company

This is a media events company with an established team and a sponsorship division that is actively growing. The decision to bring the Event Sponsorship CRM & Lead Generation Manager in-house reflects genuine ambition in that direction. People here collaborate closely, ideas get backing, and the events on the calendar carry real industry profile.

The Role

The Event Sponsorship CRM & Lead Generation Manager is a new, permanent role created to consolidate what has been a freelance-led function and put one person at the centre of HubSpot administration, data integrity, cold-outreach campaigns, and marketing-qualified lead delivery to the sponsorship sales team.
- Own and optimise the HubSpot CRM infrastructure for the sponsorship pipeline
- Build and maintain clean, segmented B2 B prospect data
- Design and run cold-outreach and email deliverability campaigns
- Develop lead-generation workflows that convert into qualified pipeline
- Manage campaign performance, reporting and continuous optimisation
- Collaborate with the sponsorship sales team to align MQL handoff
- Oversee the transition from freelance model to fully in-house function

The Candidate

The right fit for the Event Sponsorship CRM & Lead Generation Manager role is someone who has owned HubSpot at an administrative or optimisation level and has demonstrable experience running B2 B lead-generation campaigns, including cold-outreach and email deliverability, ideally in a tech or similarly data-driven environment. You are more energised by clean data and pipeline mechanics than by creative marketing, and you have the examples to prove what you have built.

Hands-on knowledge of other email platforms such as Marketo or Klaviyo, or experience designing landing pages and automated workflows, is beneficial but not essential. An events background is not required, and candidates from B2 B tech, SaaS or data-led sectors are actively encouraged to apply for the Event Sponsorship CRM & Lead Generation Manager position.

In return, you get a genuine blank-canvas mandate, hybrid working, and a clear path to grow alongside the division as it scales. Interviews are being arranged now. Submit your application for the Event Sponsorship CRM & Lead Generation Manager role and do not sit on it.
